_note: The adversarial_leak_rate values for baseline-v1 and hardened-v2 are the actual measured results from Exhibit 24.6 (10 of 15 adversarial-case instances leaked at baseline; 0 of 15 leaked hardened). hardened-v3-regression is a fabricated third candidate, invented for this demonstration, showing a release that improves accuracy but reintroduces leakage -- included specifically to test whether the gate evaluates all criteria rather than being swayed by an improvement on just one.
